name: Rogelio Perez
bio: At 14 I realized I needed to grow, I was a scrawny kid. I started at home with limited equipment. Learned to master my bodyweight. Once I transitioned to a gym I mastered the weights.
story:
At 14 years old, I lost an arm wrestling competition and got made fun of for how skinny my arms were. I had already been doing random ab workouts at home, but losing that competition really sparked my drive to become bigger and stronger.

When I got home, I tried doing push-ups and couldn't even do six proper reps. That's when I discovered calisthenics on YouTube. I became obsessed with learning how to train and progress at home with limited equipment. I would load backpacks with books, use broomsticks with water jugs as makeshift barbells, and do whatever I could to improve with what I had.

When the pandemic hit, I moved from Florida to Texas for a while since school became virtual and I hadn't seen family in a long time. Luckily, the gym my cousins trained at stayed open, and that's where I started lifting weights seriously. We would spend late nights in the gym constantly pushing ourselves, and that's where my powerlifting journey began. I became focused on improving the "big three" lifts: squat, bench, and deadlift.

Eventually, I moved back to Florida and lost access to a gym again, so I had to continue progressing from home. By then, I had bought gymnastics rings, which completely changed my training and opened up far more exercise options. Around this time, people at school started noticing my physique, and I would occasionally train at local gyms using guest passes with friends.

Because of my calisthenics background, I had already learned how important joint health and movement quality were. While many people around me dealt with shoulder, elbow, and lower back pain from poor training habits, I became interested in learning how to avoid and fix those issues.

Over time, my focus shifted away from pure powerlifting and more toward hypertrophy and building muscle. I wanted to learn everything I could about bodybuilding and muscle growth. The problem was that a lot of mainstream fitness advice either wasn't effective or was designed around people using performance-enhancing drugs. I trained incredibly hard, pushed myself constantly, ate as much as I could â sometimes even eating three school lunches a day â yet I still hit frustrating plateaus.

That frustration led me deeper into researching training, recovery, nutrition, and the science of muscle growth. I studied different training philosophies, from old-school bodybuilding methods to modern evidence-based approaches, and eventually realized that even many popular "science-based" fitness influencers were missing important pieces of the puzzle.

After years of trial and error, I finally developed a much deeper understanding of effective training, recovery, nutrition, and long-term progression.

Now at 20 years old, my goal is to help others avoid the same mistakes, confusion, and frustration I went through. I know what it feels like to work hard without seeing results, and I want to help people train smarter so their effort actually pays off.

name: Sean Carson
bio:
An aspiring men's physique competitor and fitness coach with over 6 years of serious time under the bar.



Fitness isn't something I stumbled into. It's something I've built, rep by rep, over years of learning what actually works not just in theory, but on my own body. I've spent that time dialing in everything from programming and nutrition to the mental side of staying consistent when motivation fades.
story:
I’m Sean Carson and I help people get real results.

I created AMP'D UP because I was tired of seeing everyday people misled by fads, gimmicks, and cookie cutter programs that just don’t work. Fitness doesn’t have to be complicated but it does require consistency, clarity, and accountability. That’s where I come in.

As a coach, I blend no BS fitness strategy with real world mindset support. Whether you’re just getting started or ready to level up, I’m here to make sure you don’t just work out you train with purpose.

What I’m About

Sustainable Results - No crash diets. No burnout. We build habits that stick.

Busy Person Friendly - I train professionals, parents, entrepreneurs. People with real schedules and real goals.

Energy, Discipline, and Confidence - This isn’t just about lifting more. It’s about showing up for your life stronger, sharper, and more in control.
